an3.93:2.1: Tatr' idaṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cīvarapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti -- sāṇāni pi dhārenti masāṇāni pi dhārenti chavadussāni pi dhārenti paṃsukūlāni pi dhārenti tirīṭakāni pi dhārenti ajināni pi dhārenti ajinakkhipam pi dhārenti kusacīram pi dhārenti vākacīram pi dhārenti phalakacīram pi dhārenti kesakambalam pi dhārenti vālakambalam pi dhārenti ulūkapakkhikam pi dhārenti.
an3.93:2.2: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cīvarapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti.
an3.93:3.1: Tatr' idaṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā piṇḍapātapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti --
an3.93:3.2: sākabhakkhā pi honti sāmākabhakkhā pi honti nīvārabhakkhā pi honti daddulabhakkhā pi honti haṭabhakkhā pi honti kaṇabhakkhā pi honti ācāmabhakkhā pi honti piññākabhakkhā pi honti tiṇabhakkhā pi honti gomayabhakkhā pi honti vanamūlaphalāhārā yāpenti pavattaphalabhojī.
an3.93:3.3: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā piṇḍapātapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti.
an3.93:4.1: Tatr' idaṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā senāsanapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti -- araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ susānaṃ vanapanthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ bhusāgāraṃ.
an3.93:4.2: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā senāsanapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti.
an3.93:4.3: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi aññatitthiyā paribbājakā pavivekāni paññāpenti. 2.
an3.93:5.1: Tīṇi kho imāni bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye bhikkhuno pavivekāni.
an3.93:5.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā ca hoti dussīlyañ c' assa pahīnaṃ hoti tena ca vivitto hoti,
an3.93:5.4: sammādiṭṭhiko hoti micchādiṭṭhi c' assa pahīnā hoti tāya ca vivitto hoti,
an3.93:5.5: khīṇāsavo ca hoti āsavā c' assa pahīnā honti tehi ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:5.6: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti dussīlyañ c' assa pahīnaṃ hoti tena ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:5.7: sammādiṭṭhiko hoti micchādiṭṭhi c' assa pahīnā hoti tāya ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:5.8: khīṇāsavo ca hoti āsavā c' assa pahīnā honti tehi ca vivitto hoti --
an3.93:5.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu aggappatto sārappatto suddho sāre patiṭṭhito. 3.
an3.93:6.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kassakassa gahapatissa sampannaṃ sālikkhettaṃ.
an3.93:6.2: Taṃ enaṃ kassako gahapati sīghasīghaṃ vapāpeyya,
an3.93:6.8: sīghasīghaṃ palālāni uddharāpetvā sīghasīghaṃ bhusikaṃ uddharāpeyya,
an3.93:6.13: evam assu tassa bhikkhave kassakassa gahapatissa tāni dhaññāni aggappattāni sārappattāni suddhāni sāre patiṭṭhitāni.
an3.93:7.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave <yato> bhikkhu sīlavā ca hoti dussīlyañ c' assa pahīnaṃ hoti tena ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:7.2: sammādiṭṭhiko ca hoti micchādiṭṭhi c' assa pahīnā hoti tāya ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:7.3: khīṇāsavo ca hoti āsavā c' assa pahīnā honti tehi ca vivitto hoti --
an3.93:7.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu aggappatto sārappatto suddho sāre patiṭṭhito
